Question 5

The linear transformation T has the standard matrix T=[231−2]. What are the respective images of the standard basis vectors {i,j} of R2 under the action of T?

a
 [21] and [3−2]
b
 [3−2] and [21]
c
 [23] and [1−2]
d
 [2−2] and [31]
e
 [32] and [−21]
